saints.name: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.title: Solemnity of Our Lady
saints.shortBlurb: The Church's celebration that Mary, at the end of her earthly life, was taken up body and soul into heavenly glory…
biography: On this solemnity the Church honors her belief that the Blessed Virgin Mary, having finished the course of her earthly life, was assumed body and soul into the glory of heaven. The feast is very ancient, kept in the East as the Dormition, or falling asleep, of the Mother of God and observed at Rome from at least the seventh century.

On 1 November 1950, Pope Pius XII solemnly defined the Assumption as a dogma of the faith in the Apostolic Constitution Munificentissimus Deus. The mystery holds before the whole Church the destiny promised to the redeemed, and Mary already sharing, in her whole person, in the risen life of her Son.
saints.knownFor: Mary's bodily glorification as a sign of the Church's hope.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “The Feast of the Assumption”
Pius XII, Apostolic Constitution Munificentissimus Deus (1950, vatican.va)
